name: focus-swap
title: Focus Swap
description: Moves attention between two cards (side by side in a landscape field, stacked in a portrait field) as one recedes with scale, blur and dimming while the other advances to full focus. Card words (status, title, detail) are fields.

variables.label: Final focus
variables.description: Card that ends sharp, full-size, and fully opaque.

variables.label: Unfocused blur
variables.description: Blur applied to the card outside the viewer focus.

variables.label: Unfocused opacity
variables.description: Opacity of the card outside the viewer focus.

variables.label: Card A status
variables.description: Short status word above the title of card A.

variables.label: Card A detail
variables.description: One line under the title of card A; wraps by words.
variables.default: Собрать задачу и договориться с командой

variables.label: Card B status
variables.description: Short status word above the title of card B.

variables.label: Card B detail
variables.description: One line under the title of card B; wraps by words.
